grouping.title: Geographical regions of Turkey
grouping.note: The seven regions of the First Geography Congress (Ankara, 1941), with each province in the region it is usually listed under. The 1941 boundaries themselves cross some provinces.

method: The 81 provinces of the source (ISO 3166-2 codes), simplified with mapshaper@0.7.101 (-simplify 20% weighted keep-shapes, -clean), coordinates rounded to 0.01 degrees; the regions are the provinces dissolved. Written by scripts/turkish/regions.mjs.
